title: Making AA+ Medium for Synechococcus sp. PCC 7002
author: Anne Vogel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kg3ctyn

steps.title: Prepare 1000x FeCl2 x 6H2O
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1000x FeCl2 x 6H2O stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.405g FeCl2 x 6H2O to 100mL MilliQ water.

steps.title: Prepare 100x Tris pH 8.2
steps.instruction: Prepare a 100x Tris pH 8.2 stock solution.

steps.title: Prepare 1000x Trace Mineral Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1000x Trace mineral solution using the specified compounds per liter.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following amounts per liter: H3BO3 (2.86g), MnCl2 x 4 H2O (1.81g), ZnSO4 x 7 H2O (0.222g), Na2MoO4 x 2 H2O (0.390g), CuSO4 x 5 H2O (0.079g), and Co(NO3)2 x 6 H2O (0.0494g).

steps.title: Prepare 100x AA+ Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the 100x AA+ solution and autoclave.

substeps.instruction: Add the following compounds to the desired amount of MilliQ water: NaCl (18g/L, 9g/500mL, 4.5g/250mL), MgSO4x7H2O (5g/L, 2.5g/500mL, 1.25g/250mL).
Add glycerol only if non-phototrophic growth is needed (1.1mL/L, 550μL/500mL, 275uL/250mL).
If making plates, add 15g/L agar agar.

steps.title: Final Assembly of AA+ Medium
steps.instruction: Assemble the final medium in a flow cabinet using the autoclaved and hand-warm solution.

substeps.instruction: Add the following components based on final volume: 100x Tris pH 8.2 (10mL/L, 5mL/500mL, 2.5mL/250mL), 1000x FeCl2x6H2O (1mL/L, 500μL/500mL, 250μL/250mL), 1000x Trace mineral solution (1mL/L, 500μL/500mL, 250μL/250mL), and 100x AA+ solution (10mL/L, 5mL/500mL, 2.5mL/250mL).
Add vit B12 (1mg/mL) only if using the medium immediately (4μL/L, 2μL/500mL, 1μL/250mL).
If medium containing B12 is left over, store it in a dark, cold place for a short time.
